results.title: U.S. Army officer arrested in U.K. on suspicion of trying to steal secrets for Russia - The Washington Post
results.snippet:
By Greg Miller

British police said Tuesday they had arrested a U.S. Army officer suspected of attempting to steal secret information from a NATO installation on British soil, to deliver that material to Russia.

The suspect, a 41-year-old U.S. Army officer, was arrested on suspicion of espionage as part of an operation involving Britain’s MI5 domestic security service in coordination with the FBI
